title: Beyond Gate Weights: Decision-Level Interpretation of Radiomics-Image Feature Fusion for RCC Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.14152v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gate coefficients describe how a fusion layer weights intermediate features, but they do not necessarily reflect the magnitude of branch contributions at the classifier output. We investigate this distinction in a fixed 3D MedVAE--radiomics model for clear cell versus non-clear cell renal cell carcinoma classification from contrast-enhanced CT. Because the model uses a linear classification head, the binary decision logit can be decomposed exactly into a gated image term, a direct radiomics term, and a bias. We define effective radiomics dominance as the direct radiomics term's share of the summed absolute non-bias branch contributions and compare it with structural radiomics weighting. Internally, mean structural radiomics weighting was 0.823, whereas mean effective radiomics dominance was 0.148, with a modest case-wise association (\r{ho} = 0.290). translated_title: 超越门控权重：放射组学-图像特征融合在肾细胞癌分类中的决策级解释
translated_abstract: 门控系数描述了融合层如何为中间特征分配权重，但它们并不一定反映分类器输出端各分支贡献的实际大小。我们在一个固定的 3D MedVAE——放射组学融合模型中研究了这一区别，该模型用于基于增强CT的透明细胞与非透明细胞肾细胞癌（RCC）分类。由于该模型使用线性分类头，二元决策logit可以被精确分解为一个门控图像项、一个直接放射组学项和一个偏置项。我们将“有效放射组学主导度”定义为直接放射组学项在所有非偏置分支贡献绝对值之和中所占的份额，并将其与结构性放射组学权重进行比较。在模型内部，平均结构性放射组学权重为0.823，而平均有效放射组学主导度仅为0.148，两者在个案层面仅存在中等程度的相关性（ρ = 0.290）。门控图像项保留了明显更强的判别排序信息……
tldr: 该研究提出“有效放射组学主导度”这一决策级解释指标，通过对线性分类头的logit进行精确分解，揭示融合模型中的门控权重（0.823）严重高估了放射组学分支对分类决策的实际贡献（仅为0.148）。
en_tdlr: This study introduces "effective radiomics dominance," a decision-level interpretability metric derived from exact logit decomposition of the linear classification head, revealing that gate weights (0.823) substantially overestimate the true radiomics branch contribution (only 0.148) to RCC classification decisions.
